name: wincua_type_text
description: Type text into the currently focused window using SendKeys. Special SendKeys characters (+, ^, %, ~, (, ), [, ], {, }) are automatically escaped so they type literally.

text.description: The text to type into the active window

delay_ms.description: Delay in milliseconds between keystrokes (default: 0; note: SendKeys sends atomically, this adds a pre-send pause)
